title: fw-hdl elaborated netlist: layer 1, domains and protocols
description: The normalized form of an elaborated design: the conformance artifact (netlist.md). Every implementation's conformance runner produces it; the suite compares it with a scenario's expect.json. Two implementations given the same design must produce netlists that are equal as JSON values, and byte-identical in canonical text (keys sorted, two-space indent, one trailing newline: Python json.dumps(x, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n'). Array order is normative, and given under each array. All strings are ASCII. Paths are full names (elaboration.md): the top is named 'top'. Sorting is by Unicode code point (byte-wise for ASCII), so 'u[10]' sorts before 'u[2]'.

top.description: The created type of the top component.

objects.description: Every structural object in the tree, sorted by path. Objects not in the tree after an error (a duplicate name, late creation) are absent.

nets.description: Every net, listed in the scope that formed it (connections.md). A connection that crosses a hierarchy level gives one net in each scope. Sorted by scope, then by the least path among the net's endpoints (sources, sinks, signals, inouts).

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic reported, errors, warnings and information, each (id, path) pair once, sorted by path then id. A design elaborates successfully exactly when no id begins 'FW-E-'.

protocols.description: The protocols of the design (protocols.md), keyed by the canonical type of each specialization: those named by a bundle, endpoint or converter in the tree, and those of every converter registered with one of them. Present only when there is at least one.

bindings.description: Method-level and configuration links (protocols.md): kind 'api', a port (or socket) bound by connect() or connect_up() to an export (or socket); kind 'cfg', a source pushing to a sink, bound by connect(). Sorted by kind, then from, then to. Present only when there is at least one.

listeners.description: Configuration listeners (protocols.md): one record per add_listener() on a sink made in a component's phase method (build or connect). Sorted by sink, then order. Present only when there is at least one.

path.description: A full name: 'top', then '.' and a name for each level. A name is an SV identifier with zero or more '[<decimal>]' suffixes. Domain handles in a value are written as paths.

relpath.description: A path relative to an extern component: 'clk', 'in.valid'.

type.description:
Canonical type spelling, with no spaces except before 'signed':
- bit/logic vectors: the keyword, then ' signed' if signed, then each packed dimension as '[msb:lsb]' in decimal, as declared: 'bit', 'bit[7:0]', 'logic signed[3:0]'. Other built-in integral types by keyword: 'int', 'byte', 'longint'.
- A typedef of a vector type resolves to the vector: 'u8_t' is spelled 'bit[7:0]'. A typedef of a struct, union or enum is spelled by its typedef name alone, without package or keyword: 'pair_t'.
- A class: its name without package; if it has parameters, '#(' then every parameter's value, including defaulted ones, in declaration order, separated by ',', then ')': 'fifo_chain#(bit[7:0])', 'fw_rv_if#(bit)'. A type parameter is spelled by this rule. A value parameter: an integral value in decimal (as unsigned for a sized literal: 8'hff is 255; a signed int keeps its sign: -5); a string in double quotes; an enum by its label; a struct value as "'{" then its members' values in declaration order, separated by ',', then '}': "port_c#('{16,2})".
- A class with no parameters: its name: 'leaf'.

component.description: A component. 'type' is its created type.

params.description: The resolved params value (params.md), one key per field of params_t. Empty for a component whose class (or ancestor) declares no params_t of its own. Field values: an integral field as a JSON number, the non-negative integer whose binary representation is the field's bits (int -1 is 4294967295); a value with x or z bits, or wider than 64 bits, as a string "'h" + lowercase hex; a string field as a JSON string; a constructor factory as the canonical type of the realization it creates, or null; a nested struct as an object; an unpacked array or queue as an array. A domain handle (in a domain's params) as its path, or null.

param_src.description: For each params field whose value some source changed: the last source that changed it, comparing the value before and after each source in resolution order (params.md). A field still at its mk_params default is absent, as is one a source set to the value it already had.

waivers.description: Waivers made in this component's connect phase, by waive(): sorted by a, then b, then kind. Present only when there is at least one.

port_names.description: Port names this component set for its class, by port_name(): kind name -> association name -> port name. Present only when there is at least one.

provides.description: Derivations this component stated by provides(): kind name -> association name -> params, written as a domain's params. Present only when there is at least one.

extern.description: Present exactly when the component is an extern: its recorded pin map (extern.md).

params.description: Module parameter name -> its value, from param(). A name set twice keeps the later value. 'type' is the value's type T in the canonical spelling (#/$defs/type), or 'type' for fw_type #(T) (a parameter type). 'value' is spelled as a class's value parameter is (#/$defs/type): an integral value in decimal (as unsigned for an unsigned type, with its sign for a signed one), a string in double quotes, an enum by its label, a packed struct as "'{" members "}"; for a type, the type's canonical spelling.

pins.description: Module pin -> the port it maps to, as a path relative to the extern; for a field of a member mapped field-wise (extern.md, Fields), the member's path then the field path ('aw.data.addr'). One entry per port and bundle member of the extern that is not unused (pin(), a prefix rule, or the default rule), or per field of a field-wise member. If two ports map to one pin (FW-E-EXT-PIN), the one created first is listed.

ties.description: Module pin -> tied value, from tie().

open.description: Module pins left open, from open(), sorted.

unused.description: Ports with no pin, from unused(): each leaf port as a path relative to the extern, sorted.

domain_pins.description: Domain pins, from pin() and pin_out() of fw_domain (domains.md): module pin -> its mapping. 'domain' is the domain's path after a null argument is resolved, or null when it resolved to none (FW-E-DOM-NONE). 'dir' is 'in' for pin(), 'out' for pin_out(). 'attr' is the pin_attr_t value, written as params are. If one pin name is mapped twice (FW-E-EXT-PIN), the first is listed. Present only when there is at least one.

signal.description: A local signal. 'type' is its value type T; 'width' is $bits(T).

port.description: A port, on a component or a member of a bundle. 'type' is its value type T; 'width' is $bits(T). 'dir' is the effective direction seen from the port's scope (the component that owns it, or the outermost bundle it is in): the declared direction, flipped by each mirror on the path from the scope, and 'in' if any monitor is on that path; 'inout' stays 'inout' (bundles.md). For a port declared directly on a component it is the declared direction.

bundle.description: A bundle in a role: 'bundle' (initiator), 'mirror' or 'monitor'. 'type' is the bundle type B, without the role: 'fw_rv_if#(bit[7:0])'. Its members are listed as objects of their own.

protocol.description: The protocol the bundle type names with fw_bundle_protocol, as a key of 'protocols'. Absent when it names none.

role.description: Its role in the protocol (fw_protocol::role_of). Present exactly when 'protocol' is.

value.description: A constant: "'h" then lowercase hex digits, without leading zeros ('h0 for zero), x and z for unknown digits: "'h5a".

net.description: One net: the endpoints joined, transitively, by the connections and ties a scope made, classified by their role in that scope (connections.md). Every key is always present.

source.description: The source endpoint, or null when the net is driven by a tie, by inouts, or by nothing. With several sources (FW-E-NET-MULTI) it is the least of them.

tie.description: The tied value, or null. A tie is a source. With several tied endpoints (FW-E-NET-MULTI), the value tied to the least of them.

signals.description: Local signals of the scope on the net, sorted.

diagnostic.description: A diagnostic: its stable id and the path it names (diagnostics.md says which object each id names). The path is '' when there is none (a global override).

assoc.description: Associations made on this object by set() (domains.md): kind name (the kind class's canonical type spelling, 'fw_clock_kind') -> association name ('' for the default) -> the domain's path. Only the associations made on the object itself, not those it inherits by lookup. Present only when there is at least one.

domain.description: A domain object (domains.md). 'type' is its created type, 'fw_domain#(fw_clock_kind)'. 'params' is its params value, written as a component's params are, each domain handle as its path.

drivers.description: Its drivers: drive() as {'signal', 'attr'}, pin_out() as {'extern', 'pin', 'attr'}; 'attr' written as params are. Sorted by signal or extern path, then pin.

protocol.description: One protocol specialization. 'family' is the class name; 'params' its parameter values, written as a component's params are; 'prefix' the prefix of derived names.

apis.description: The APIs declare() registers, sorted by dir.

bundles.description: Bundle types that name the protocol, sorted.

converters.description: Registered transactors and abstractors, sorted by type. A transactor has from == to == this protocol and a role; an abstractor has no role.

api_endpoint.description: A method-level endpoint: fw_port, fw_export or fw_socket. 'type' is its created type, 'fw_socket#(fw_put_if#(...),fw_put_if#(...))'; 'protocol' the protocol, when one is known.

cfg_endpoint.description: A configuration source or sink (protocols.md). 'type' is its created type, 'fw_cfg_sink#(uart_cfg_t)'.

binding.description: One link. For 'api', 'from' is the port side and 'to' the export side; a connect_up() is a link from the inner endpoint to the outer one (for an export, from the outer to the inner). For 'cfg', 'from' is the source and 'to' the sink.

listener.description: One add_listener() call. 'sink' is the sink (cfg_sink or a configured endpoint) the call was made on. 'order' is the call's position among the recorded calls on that sink, from 0: the order in which a change runs the listeners' changed(). 'scope' is the component whose phase method made the call. 'listener' is the path of the listening object when it is an fw object in the tree (a component, an endpoint), else null: a plain object (held in a member or a local) has no path, and its class cannot be named at run time, so it is identified only by sink, order and scope.
